Entity.description:
Represents an autonomous, structural, or physical object participating in the world.

Entities represent actors, physical facilities, geographic regions, vehicles,
suppliers, or any discrete organizational participant.

attributes.description: Immutable property map associated with this entity.
attributes.title: Attributes

tags.description: Categorical tags for grouping and querying entities.
tags.title: Tags

Entity.title: Entity

Relationship.description:
Represents a directed, typed relational edge between two entities.

Models structural, logistical, dependency, or jurisdictional relations
(e.g., 'supplies', 'depends_on', 'connected_to', 'serves').

attributes.description: Attributes associated with this relation (e.g., distance, bandwidth).
attributes.title: Attributes

Relationship.title: Relationship

Resource.description:
Represents a finite, bounded, or measurable quantity in the enterprise.

Models physical stock, vehicle fleets, operational budgets, bed capacities,
workforce hours, or bandwidth.

current.description: Current quantity or stock of the resource.
current.title: Current

entity_id.description: Optional entity ID owning or hosting this resource.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

max_value.description: Maximum capacity or upper bound limit.
max_value.title: Max Value

Resource.title: Resource

description:
Canonical representation of the enterprise or ecosystem state at a point in time.

Formal Conceptual Representation:
    S_t = (G_t, R_t, M_t, \Gamma_t, C_t)
where:
    G_t = Entities and typed relationships
    R_t = Measurable finite resources and capacities
    M_t = Temporal memory and operational history
    \Gamma_t = Active operational rules and policy parameters
    C_t = Exogenous and environmental context

WorldState is immutable (frozen=True), branchable, serializable, and auditable.

active_rules.description: Active policy parameters, operational thresholds, and rule flags.
active_rules.title: Active Rules

context.description: Environmental, economic, or meteorological context variables.
context.title: Context

entities.description: Active participating entities keyed by EntityId.
entities.title: Entities

memory.description: Relevant temporal memory, running statistics, or history lags.
memory.title: Memory

relationships.description: Immutable sequence of directed relational edges between entities.
relationships.title: Relationships

resources.description: Finite or measurable resources keyed by ResourceId.
resources.title: Resources

title: WorldState
